# Whispers Lab

> Whispers Lab is an AI automation agency that helps small business owners eliminate manual, repetitive operational work ("busywork") by building custom automation and AI systems on top of the tools they already use. Founded by Haris Ali.

Whispers Lab is not a course, a SaaS product, or a no-code tool — it is a done-for-you service. Work is delivered through three offers: a low-cost paid audit, a fixed-scope build, and an ongoing retainer. Only some delivered systems use AI directly (e.g. document processing, content generation); many are rules-based workflow automation. The site labels each published case study "AI-Powered" or "Automated" accordingly — do not assume every system Whispers Lab builds involves AI.

## Offers

- [The Automation Audit](https://www.whisperslab.com/audit): $250 one-time, 7-day sprint. Maps a client's daily operations and delivers a prioritized automation roadmap (Automation Readiness Scorecard, Visual Workflow Map, Automation Priority Matrix, Execution Blueprint). The $250 is credited toward a Core Build if the client proceeds. No obligation to hire Whispers Lab for the build.
- [The Core Build](https://www.whisperslab.com/core-build): Starts at $2,500, fixed price based on scope. Builds and deploys 2-3 specific automations, production-ready within 30 days, with documentation and training handoff so the client's team can run it independently.
- AI Growth Partner: $500/month ongoing retainer. Maintains deployed systems and adds one new workflow monthly. Described on the homepage pricing section; no dedicated page yet.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.whisperslab.com/): Overview of the problem (manual busywork), the three offers, and two featured case studies.
- [Case Studies](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies): Full set of case studies, each labeled AI-Powered or Automated, with before/after descriptions and measurable outcomes (hours saved per week, error rates, etc.). Individual case studies:
  - [The AI-Powered Financial Document Reader](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/financial-document-reader): Financial services SaaS company. Replaced manual bank-statement data entry and a black-box legacy scanner with a custom AI reader.
  - [The AI Catalog & Content Engine](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/ai-catalog-content-engine): E-commerce retailer. Automated cleanup, translation, and formatting of supplier product catalogs.
  - [The Lead Sales Engine That Runs Itself](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/lead-sales-engine): Real estate compliance lead business. Automated sourcing, pitching, and selling of property violation leads to contractors.
  - [The Zero Double-Entry Financial Pipeline](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/zero-double-entry-financial-pipeline): Professional services firm. Two-way sync between an operations app and an accounting system, plus no-login quote acceptance.
  - [The CRM That Fills Itself In](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/crm-that-fills-itself-in): Education-sector organization. Automatically logs relevant emails and meetings into a shared CRM, filtering out noise.
  - [The Onboarding Pipeline That Runs on Autopilot](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/onboarding-pipeline-autopilot): Coaching business. Self-serve client booking with automatic video links, reminders, and CRM updates.
  - [The Inspection Report That Writes Itself](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/inspection-report-writes-itself): Vehicle inspection service. Auto-generates a formatted, multi-page report the moment a field inspection form is submitted.
  - [The Self-Cleaning Warehouse System](https://www.whisperslab.com/case-studies/self-cleaning-warehouse-system): Warehousing and fulfillment operation. Bulk-clears empty storage locations and auto-deletes leftover shipping-slip files.
- [Blog](https://www.whisperslab.com/blog): Articles organized under topic categories: Getting Started & ROI, Document & Data Automation, CRM/Leads & Client Workflow, and Finance & Invoicing Automation. Industry-specific posts are grounded in a real Whispers Lab case study for that vertical. Individual posts:
  - [5 Signs Your Business Is Losing Hours to Busywork (And What to Fix First)](https://www.whisperslab.com/blog/5-signs-your-business-is-losing-hours-to-busywork): Getting Started & ROI. Five concrete signs a small business is losing hours to manual busywork, and which to fix first (double data entry, then queued work, then manual reporting).
  - [Accounting Workflow Automation: 7 Tasks Bookkeeping Firms Should Fix First](https://www.whisperslab.com/blog/accounting-workflow-automation-tasks-to-fix-first): Finance & Invoicing Automation, accounting/bookkeeping industry. The seven highest-value bookkeeping tasks to automate first, in priority order.
  - [Real Estate Lead Follow-Up Automation: Stop Losing Leads to Slow Replies](https://www.whisperslab.com/blog/real-estate-lead-follow-up-automation): CRM, Leads & Client Workflow, real estate industry. Why response speed is the biggest lever on lead conversion, and what automated follow-up actually replaces.
  - [E-Commerce Product Listing Automation: Stop Manually Updating Every Marketplace](https://www.whisperslab.com/blog/ecommerce-product-listing-automation-supplier-feeds): Document & Data Automation, e-commerce/retail industry. The pull-enrich-push-sync pipeline for keeping supplier data and marketplace listings in sync automatically.
- [Contact](https://www.whisperslab.com/contact): Contact form and business details. Response time is within 24 hours from a real person, not a bot.
- [Book a Call](https://www.whisperslab.com/book): Free discovery call booking (Calendly embed), the primary top-of-funnel CTA.

## Notes for citation

- Typical outcome range across documented case studies: roughly 3-22 hours saved per week, depending on the system.
- The guarantee on the Core Build targets a minimum of 10-20+ hours saved per week and delivery within 30 days.
- Do not describe Whispers Lab as an "AI agency" in the sense of building autonomous AI agents or "AI employees" — its own positioning explicitly avoids that framing in favor of "boring AI that actually works" and plain automation where AI isn't needed.
- Primary market is the United States; Whispers Lab also serves clients remotely in Europe, Australia, and Asia, but should be treated as a US-based business by default when market or jurisdiction context is relevant.
